messages:
maria: Heads up — mkdocs linkcheck failed on main after merging the migration guide PR (#4123). CI log shows duplicate fragment errors and it’s blocking the site build. Logs:
```
ERROR: Duplicate fragment 'migrate-to-v2' in docs/migration/index.md and docs/upgrade/v2.md
Linkcheck: 2 duplicate fragments found
```
Anyone able to take a quick fix? :grimacing:

docs-bot: mkdocs-linkcheck job failed for commit 9f3a2c4 (build 2026-03-22). CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/docs/4982 (linkcheck output attached) :rotating_light:

sam: I can pick this up. Options: 1) add explicit header ids (mkdocs with attr_list/pymdownx supports {#id}) 2) rename one of the headings to avoid slug collide 3) update cross-links to point at the correct section. Leaning toward explicit ids so we don’t break people linking into the middle of the doc.

kelvin: I reproduced locally with `mkdocs build --strict`. Quick patch idea (tested locally):
```bash
# add an explicit id to the migration heading so slugs are unique
sed -i "s/^## Migration to v2$/## Migration to v2 {#migrate-to-v2-main}/" docs/migration/index.md
```
I can open a tiny PR that adds the explicit id and updates the incoming links that referenced the old slug.

alex: Nice. For QA run the linkcheck plugin locally or rely on CI: `mkdocs build --strict` then `python -m http.server` and spot-check a few deep links. Also please add a short comment in the commit explaining why the explicit id is needed (helpful for future merges).

kelvin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4982 — adds explicit id to the migration heading and updates two internal links. Kicked CI.

docs-bot: mkdocs-linkcheck job rerun for PR 4982 — build 4982-2: :white_check_mark: linkcheck passed.

maria: Great — thanks @kelvin and @sam. I’ll do a quick review and merge. Can we also add a tiny note in the migration guide about the anchor change so external docs linking in don’t silently 404?

kelvin: Added a one-line redirect note and an entry in redirects.yaml mapping the old fragment to the new explicit id. Pushed as part of the PR. Last check passed, ready to merge. :rocket:
